# Tray trial B

## What it is

A wholly fictional lab record, `aster-tray-b-v1`; the header identifies the author
and 2026-09-08 observation. Its publication date is unknown, not inferred from
the observation date. This is not real experimental evidence.

## Claims

- B1 — Source claim: in one nominal 22 C trial, open reached the target in
  25 minutes and closed in 19 minutes. Evidence: `raw/trial-b.md`, Measurements.
- B2 — Author's view: recommend closed for that nominal setup, with a single-trial
  limitation and no humidity measurement. Evidence: `raw/trial-b.md`, Recommendation.

## Why it matters here

Trial B's recommendation conflicts with [[wiki/sources/trial-a|Trial A]], claim A2
(raw Recommendation, published 2026-09-01). Its later observation does not prove
that A was wrong or superseded.
